“Admirable spirit. Judging by that display, you have no need of a hospital.”

“Huh—? Wait. What are you doing here, Kirei…?”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“That’s the spirit. It seems there is no need for hospitalization.”
“EhKotomine…?”

pages.ja:
「……それは私の台詞だ。
凛とおまえ、二人して玄関に捨てられていてな。
捨て子にしては可愛げがないので見捨てたかったが、揃いも揃って衰弱しきっていた。放っておけば死体が二つ並ぶ事になる。教会としては体裁が悪いのでな、仕方なく治療してやったのだ」

pages.en:
“…That is my question to you.

“You and Rin had both been discarded at the front entrance.

“Neither of you had the charm one expects of an abandoned child, so I would gladly have left you there. Unfortunately, you were both thoroughly exhausted. Had I done nothing, two corpses would have lain side by side before the church. The appearance would have been unfortunate, so I had no choice but to treat you.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“…That is my line.
You and Rin were abandoned at the door.
I wanted to leave you two, since you made a rather ugly pair as abandoned children go, but you were also dead on your feet. Had I done nothing, there would have been two dead bodies in front of my church. A church cannot afford that image, so I had no choice but to treat you.”

pages.en:
“A little after three in the morning. You have been asleep for approximately twelve hours since you were brought here.”

“—Twelve hours? That's half an entire day…!”

I rise from the pew where I had been lying.

Like hell I can afford to rest that long…!
pages.mirrorMoon:
“It is three in the morning. You have been sleeping for about twelve hours since you were carried here.”
“Twelve hours!? That’s half a day…!”
I get up from the chair I was lying on.
I can’t lie around like this…!

pages.ja: 「言峰、遠坂は！？ 俺と一緒に倒れてたんだろう、あいつは！？」
pages.jaRuby: 「言峰、遠坂は！？ 俺と一緒に倒れてたんだろう、あいつは！？」
pages.en: “Kirei, where's Tohsaka!? She collapsed with me, didn't she!?”
pages.mirrorMoon: “Kotomine, where’s Tohsaka!? She was there too, right!? Where is she!?”

「凛は遠坂の家で休ませている。
おまえは体力だけだったが、アレは魔力を根こそぎ奪われていたからな。通常、持ち直すには七日はかかるが、遠坂の土はアレによく馴染む。
順当に行けば、明日の昼には意識を取り戻すだろう」
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
“Rin is resting at the Tohsaka residence.

“Only your physical strength was taken. Her magical energy was drained to the roots. Ordinarily, she would need seven days to recover, but the soil of the Tohsaka estate agrees remarkably well with her.

“If all proceeds as expected, she should regain consciousness by noon tomorrow.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“I have Rin resting at her place.
You only had your energy taken away, but she had her magical energy taken away. It would normally take seven days to recover, but the land of Tohsaka is good for her.
If all goes well, she should regain consciousness by tomorrow afternoon.”

pages.ja:
「
そうか。命に別状はないんだな？」
「ない。あの土地の土は特別だ。なにしろ吸血種が寝床にしていた曰くつきの霊脈だ。遠坂の後継者である凛なら、一晩埋めておけば減らず口を取り戻すだろう」
pages.jaRuby:
「

pages.en:
“—I see. Her life isn't in danger, then?”

“It is not. The soil there is exceptional. That land is a spiritual vein with a dark history: it once served as the lair of a bloodsucking creature. As the Tohsaka heir, Rin need only be buried there overnight to recover her sharp tongue.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“I see. So her life’s not in danger?”
“No. The soil of that land is special. It is a ley line that is said to have been home to vampires. Rin is her family’s heir, so she will be back to her impudent self if I keep her buried for a day.”

pages.mirrorMoon:
“……”
I think I heard something I’m not used to hearing, but I decide not to ask about it.
Let’s hope he doesn’t literally mean “bury”.

“—Then that's all I needed to hear. Thanks for treating us.”

I leave the church behind.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“I see. Thanks for the care.”
I leave the church.

桜を追う。
イリヤを連れ戻す。桜を連れ戻す。
好きな相手を守りきる。
勝敗が決したからなんだ。
俺にはまだ戦う力が残っている。
なら、ここで踏み止まっている場合じゃない。

pages.en:
I know what I have to do.

Go after Sakura.

Bring Illya back. Bring Sakura back.

Protect the person I love to the very end.

Who cares if the outcome is already decided?

I still have strength left to fight.

Then I have no business standing still here.
pages.mirrorMoon:
I know what I have to do.
Follow Sakura.
Bring back Illya. Bring back Sakura.
Protect the one I love.
So what if the fight’s outcome is already determined?
I still have the power to fight.
So this is no time to be hesitating.

“And where do you intend to go, Shirou Emiya? I confess I do not understand the situation.”

“Where else? Illya went with Sakura willingly to protect us. …She told her to come to the castle if she wanted her formal dress. I don't know what that dress is, but the castle has to be their destination.”

“So, where are you going, Emiya Shirou? I do not know the situation.”
“…? It’s obvious. Illya went with Sakura to protect us. She said to go to the castle if Sakura wants her formal dress. I don’t know what this formal dress is, but they’re likely heading to her castle.”

pages.mirrorMoon:
“Formal dress…? No, never mind that. Matou Sakura has become your enemy? Then the victor of this Holy Grail War is decided.”
“…………”

pages.en:
Zouken and Sakura.

Sakura is unquestionably the superior Master, but she cannot defy Zouken.

…I don't know what she means to do with Illya, but if she encounters Zouken, it will all be over.

However fiercely Sakura rejects him, the Crest Worms inside her will seize control of her.

Zouken and Sakura.
Sakura is obviously the superior Master, but she can’t disobey Zouken.
…I don’t know what she’s trying to do with Illya, but it’ll end once she meets Zouken.
No matter how much Sakura refuses him, the crest worm in her body will control her.

“Why? There’s no reason for you to help me.”
“Of course not. It is just this one time. Do not consider me your ally after we rescue Illyasviel. We can never understand each other.”
“Then…”
